gitCommit.subject: Benchmark: restore upstream's workflow files in the working tree before the tests
gitCommit.body:
Benchmark: restore upstream's workflow files in the working tree before the tests

Some e2e scenarios read .github/workflows (static-checks.yml and others), which this
copy deletes so nothing runs on its own. A step puts the deleted files back from the
upstream-tree commit on every runner; they are not committed, so they stay inactive.

specs.title: audio earlier versions saved to Cache Storage is deleted when the app starts @scenario:tts-legacy-disk-cache-purged-at-startup
the runner covers every workspace with a test suite @scenario:test-turbo-covers-every-workspace-suite
every suite runs instead of replaying a cached result @scenario:test-turbo-always-runs-every-suite
each suite starts after the builds its specs import @scenario:each-suite-waits-for-the-builds-it-imports
every variable the caller sets reaches jest @scenario:live-suite-env-reaches-jest
a package build hashes its shipped assets but not its specs @scenario:a-spec-edit-keeps-the-package-build-cached
the client package rebuilds when its baked logger setting changes @scenario:client-package-build-tracks-baked-env
collects coverage only when the run asks for it @scenario:client-coverage-runs-only-when-requested
an edit carried through a response is saved once it ends @scenario:an-edit-carried-through-a-response-saves-after-it
a color token this version does not know is ignored and the theme still loads @scenario:yaml-theme-unknown-color-kept
a bad token value is reported with its path and the theme is dropped @scenario:yaml-theme-bad-value-reported
a misspelled bundled theme name falls back with a warning @scenario:yaml-theme-unknown-name-falls-back
a valid inline theme loads exactly as written @scenario:yaml-theme-valid-unchanged
a config reload with a broken theme applies the same fallback @scenario:yaml-theme-reload-falls-back
an invalid key outside the theme still stops startup @scenario:yaml-theme-other-errors-still-exit
machine API creates, lists, reads, updates, rejects stale writes and deletes individual files
authorized management deletion cleans a seeded other-author file through the real Local adapter
browser-authenticated multipart binary upload reads exact bytes, replaces by revision and deletes
imports an archive with text and binary attachments and physically cleans all files on deletion
ordinary local upload lists persisted metadata and physically deletes through the shared file route
ordinary provider-routed upload reaches the model and persists in chat with an unambiguous attachment selector
thread survives a mid-stream interrupt and matches its own post-reload rendering
older-branch selection and sibling counters survive a follow-up turn and reload
a live manual compaction stays below the turn it summarizes
a compaction resumed after a reload keeps the thread it summarizes
